newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end lackluster session mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end lackluster session mixed.

text.p: May 22 - U.S. debt futures ended a lethargic day mixed with June T-bond down in pre-holiday trade. Euros shut at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT Friday and T-bonds end at 1210 CDT/1510 GMT for long Memorial Day weekend. No trade Monday. "We're done for the week," a Euro floor source said. He noted market tried to rally after FOMC minutes, couldn't muster much interest.
